source.label: NRCan Comprehensive Energy Use Database (CEUD)
source.note: Modelled by NRCan from surveys and energy balances - estimates, not meter readings.

res_region_energy.label: residential energy use
res_region_energy.note: Territories are reported as one group.

com_region_energy.label: commercial and institutional energy use
com_region_energy.note: Regions follow NRCan's grouping; 'Atlantic' and 'British Columbia & Territories' are combined regions, so sizes are not like-for-like with a single province.

ind_region_energy.label: industrial energy use
ind_region_energy.note: Regions follow NRCan's grouping; 'Atlantic' and 'British Columbia & Territories' are combined regions, so sizes are not like-for-like with a single province.

tran_region_energy.label: transportation energy use
tran_region_energy.note: Regions follow NRCan's grouping; 'Atlantic' and 'British Columbia & Territories' are combined regions, so sizes are not like-for-like with a single province.

res_region_ghg.label: greenhouse-gas emissions from homes
res_region_ghg.note: Direct (on-site) emissions only: burning gas, oil or wood in the home. Emissions from generating electricity are not counted, so provinces that heat with hydro look very low.

sector_energy.label: energy use by sector
sector_energy.note: The five CEUD end-use sectors. Shares are of their sum; electricity generation and oil & gas production fuel are outside these tables except where counted under industry.

res_gas_share.label: natural-gas share of home energy
res_gas_share.note: Share of each region's own residential energy use.

res_elec_share.label: electricity share of home energy
res_elec_share.note: Share of each region's own residential energy use.

res_heat_share.label: space-heating share of home energy
res_heat_share.note: Share of each region's own residential energy use.
